items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: Yeah, because through him, that's the way I met Bunk.

ctx.x: Um, but he- He's one they call Candy, isn't it? Yeah. Yeah. Is he able to talk? I wondered maybe if we could interview him someday. Yeah, he could talk. Because he knew quite a bit about Bunk, too.
